author: Scott Manley

A question that sometimes comes up is how dangerous an air leak on a spaceship is? Will a tiny hole cause the destruction of the entire station due to the 'infinite vacuum of space'? How long do you have to fix a problem or abandon ship? 
These are all things you can calculate.
